cost: Validation O(module bytes) plus engine-specific validation; run interpreter work up to optional fuel, with separate host work and allocations. fd allocation O(slots); iov O(n+bytes)+Vfs; random O(len); poll O(subscriptions); readdir O(entries+names).
description: Host validates a wasm module, registers preview1 functions, then creates a fresh Store per run. Ctx transports guest byte coordinates through descriptor/path checks to Vfs; captures streams, virtual time, seeded randomness and call counts. Macro wrappers require exported memory before counting. proc_exit is separate and preserves its code; other traps return134. Name-only missing_imports is weaker than successful linking.
